text:
sara: rolling out v2026.03.21-rc3 to eu1 now. quick post-deploy checklist — I care most about prefills, kv warmup, and synth heartbeats. will watch for p95 latency spike :eyes:

sara: deploy window is 16:10-16:40 UTC, we should be able to finish within it. tagging @kim for rollout gate decision if anything odd shows up.

deploy-bot: deployment v2026.03.21-rc3 started on eu1 — canary at 5%. smoke probes scheduled in 30s. (logs: https://deploys/redwood/1754329876)

matt: saw a tiny p95 bump on canary at 16:12, +30ms, not alarming yet. no 5xx.

kim: copy. matt — can you paste the synth probe command you ran? I want to replay against the canary instances.

matt: sure — running `./scripts/synth_probe.sh --region eu1 --model embed-small --samples 50`

matt: output (summary): success=50 fail=0 p50=18ms p95=72ms p99=110ms

sam: running a prefix cache check now, will post results.

sam: `curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.redwood/api/v1/debug/prefix-check -d '{"prefix":"hello world","route":"embed-small"}'` -> 200, ttl=34s, hit_ratio=0.88

ops-oncall: @sara quick note — KV warmup showed one host with delayed warmup (~90s) but it recovered. tracking host-id i-0a1b2c3d in infra. no customer-facing errors.

sara: thanks — keep an eye on that host. if it flaps again we pin traffic back to previous model variant. threshold: if any host >3min warmup or >0.5% 5xx across canary we pause.

deploy-bot: canary smoke results: 200/200 probes OK, 5xx=0.0%, avg latency +28ms vs baseline. continuing to 25% in 10m unless hold requested.

kim: request to run an end-to-end sample with L1 routing and fallback to quant-variant, just to validate fallback path. small script:```bash
# run 20 e2e samples via routing proxy
for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -X POST https://eu1-proxy.redwood/reply -d '{"input":"test e2e $i","route":"chat-default"}'; done
```

sam: ran that loop, saw 20/20 replies, no timeouts, avg latency 240ms. one reply had a slight truncation but looks like tokenizer boundary, not model hang.

matt: telemetry: token emission steady, no KV cache thrash. spike in mem usage on the delayed host (ops-oncall's host) peaked at 78% then normalized.

ops-oncall: I drained the host and restarted the warmup daemon as a precaution. redeploy-bot marked it healthy after 2 warmup cycles.

sara: ok — consensus? I'm leaning to continue rollout to 50% after the 10m window. no blockers called so far. any objections? @kim @matt @ops-oncall

kim: no objections. recommend we leave a canary pin metric: if global p95 > baseline + 50ms for 5m -> auto-pin.

matt: agreed. I'll add quick alarm on the canary metric dashboard and post the link.

deploy-bot: rollout progressing to 25% as scheduled. next checkpoint at 16:25 UTC.

sara: note for release notes: include kv warmup incident (transient host warmup delay), action taken: drained host + restarted warmup daemon, no customer impact. also mention router fallback verification passed.

sam: small follow-up: we should add the `--warmup-grace` flag to the warmup daemon for this host type to reduce recovery time. filing PR: https://git/repo/pull/4021

kim: thumbs up on PR. if anything degrades in next checkpoint, we pin back to v2026.03.20-stable and open a hotfix.

deploy-bot: checkpoint 16:25 — canary metrics stable. automated quickchecks: pass. advancing to 50%.

ops-oncall: monitoring — set up a temporary synthetic that pings tokenization & routing every 30s for next 30m. alert if 5xx>0.3% or p95>baseline+50ms.

sara: excellent. thanks team — I'll update the release notes draft and close the window if 50% looks good at the 16:40 check. :tada:
